verdict.label: separate
verdict.why: Both functions recursively walk the same SchemaAST node kinds (suspend, union, arrays, objects). However, assertPortable is a single-tree predicate with memoization, cycle handling, annotation, check and declaration portability policy, and tagged-error special casing. sameRuntimeEncoding is a pairwise structural-equality comparison that checks tags, encoding links, checks and context. The shared part is only AST traversal boilerplate, which is generic syntax. A generic child-enumeration helper could exist in principle, but the two walks have different contracts, so no meaningful shared operation is established.

provider_context_limit: Claude canonical shared-operations prompt includes full candidate code, not supplemental caller files. Jev uses bounded context; source worker/coordinator inspect callers separately.
